text: As I move from the sterile corridor to this vibrant, immersive exhibition space, I feel a sense of curiosity awakened within me. The "R+D" display, highlighting responsive and innovative research, evokes in me a subtle thrill—an intellectual invitation to ponder how humans and technology merge. Amid these carefully crafted environments, I feel both small and significant, as if my very presence is part of this ongoing dialogue between human curiosity and technological progress.
